name: Grand Central Wiring
old_description: Our mission is to make the process of selecting and installing your electronics effortless so you can focus on enjoying them. Whether you desire speakers on your terrace, a television located above your home fireplace or in your office lobby, several remote controls combined into one, or your own custom idea brought to reality, Grand Central Wiring ensures that your experience will be superior. We offer a variety of services customized to your needs.
about:
Grand Central Wiring was founded in 2006 by Jason Gillespie in Greenville, South Carolina. The company began as an audio/video design and build firm, focusing on residential and light commercial installations.

The company provides a range of services including home theater installation, TV mounting, universal remote programming, structured wiring for data, telephone, video, and security systems, as well as smart home automation, lighting control, and video surveillance. They also offer construction-related services such as design-build movie cinemas, sheetrock repair, painting, framing, and masonry through a licensed home builder, Phil Gillespie. The firm carries products from brands like Samsung, SunBriteTV, Denon, Yamaha, Sonos, and others, and wires for local TV and internet providers including Charter, AT&T, DirecTV, and Dish.

Grand Central Wiring serves homeowners, businesses, and custom home builders in the Greenville area. Projects have included outdoor terrace speakers, lobby television installations, whole-home audio distribution, and security camera systems for both new construction and retrofit applications. The company works with residential clients as well as commercial spaces such as office lobbies and gaming rooms.

The company emphasizes free estimates, a satisfaction guarantee on workmanship, and an extended warranty on products sold through them. Their stated philosophy is that technology should be easy to use and seamless, with a focus on concealing wiring and equipment while delivering reliable performance.
